description: This mod adds Kirby as a Pokémon to Cobblemon! This ultra-rare Pokémon can be found spawning in Flower Forest biomes.  Type: Pure Fairy Base Stats: Identical to Scream Tail Ability – Copycat: Upon entering battle, Kirby copies the highest base stat of its opponent, adapting to the enemy it faces.

mods.name: Cobblemon Kirby
mods.description: Adds Kirby (#1984, Fairy) to Cobblemon with a custom model, animations and the signature ability Copy Ability, which copies the highest base stat of the opposing Pokémon.
